description: Point-in-time dealer gamma exposure for US stocks and ETFs, one row per ticker per session, each stamped with knowledge_time (17:00 New York on the session date). Columns: spot, net_gex_bn (dealer net gamma, $bn per 1% move; >0 dealers long gamma, <0 short), call_gex_bn, put_gex_bn, flip (gamma-flip level), call_wall, put_wall, pcr_oi, atm_iv_pct. Give ticker (+ start/end) for a time series, or date alone for every name that session ranked by |net_gex_bn|. Rows after as_of are hidden. A ticker series also returns `summary`: regime (long/short gamma), distance to the flip and walls, and a one-line read to quote. Free keys see the last 30 days; meta.upgrade then lists one-click checkout links ($49 one ticker since 2010, $19 last 5 years, $295 every ticker) to show the user.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_gex
title: Get point-in-time GEX (dealer gamma)
